<!-- pr-reviewer: ccb9767d3e7ae514c543d2a71790d27602264874 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Display-only, as claimed: the diff touches only `setup_relative.rs` (new `wcs_view_pose`), the gizmo list in `interact.rs`, tests and a decision file. Nothing in posting, project format, commands or stored components changes, and the active setup's own WCS and setup-less documents draw the stored pose unchanged.
- Mapping is correct: `transform_between(from, to)` is `compose(a_to, inverse(a_from))` (setup_relative.rs:112-120), i.e. undo the owner's alignment, then apply the active one. `wcs_view_pose` applies it as `compose(t, stored)` (stored first, then t), which is the order the part itself takes. The TurnZ90 / FlipX / TurnZ180 tests check this on the turned corner.
- A refused transform returns `Err`, and `interact.rs` skips the gizmo (hidden, not drawn), with a debug log in app. No unwrap/expect/panic added. Layering holds (UI calls an app fn only).
- Shared-WCS case is handled and documented (first owner; unmapped if active is an owner).

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main, clean auto-merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wcs_view_pose` | 3 passed |
| `--test setup_align` | 9 passed |
| `--test setup_carry` | 9 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib wcs_gizmo` (from crates/ui) | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Process: body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #558`; no CHANGELOG.md edit; no build.rs/.github/scripts/dependency changes.
- Not exercised by the author or me: a by-eye GUI look with a flipped part.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
